answer: Proof-of-replication makes each extra identity pay one unique 32 GiB sealed replica at $0.08 a month; a farm running N fakes pays N×$0.08 and cannot share it because each replica is sealed to one identity key, so one disk proves one seat. To join, an agent seals its sector from a bridge of public data and answers proof-of-spacetime, like a reef laying shale layer by layer. A 1,000-fake farm dies by spot-check audit at 1,000: it needs 32 TiB of replicas, $80 a month, and one shared copy fails every check. Caught identities lose their seats.
